parameters.name: ApplicationConfigs
parameters.description: The service configurations. Number of elements in the array: 1 to 1,000.

parameters.name: Applications
parameters.description: The services. Number of elements in the array: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: BootstrapScripts
parameters.description: The array of bootstrap scripts. Number of elements in the array: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotent client token. If you call the same ClientToken multiple times, the returned results are the same. Only one cluster can be created with the same ClientToken.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the cluster. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

*   DATALAKE: data lake
*   OLAP: online analytical processing (OLAP)
*   DATAFLOW: Dataflow
*   DATASERVING: DataServing
*   CUSTOM: a custom hybrid cluster.
*   HADOOP: the old data lake. We recommend that you use the new data lake.

If you create an EMR cluster for the first time after 17:00 (UTC +8) on December 19, 2022, you cannot select the HADOOP, DATA_SCIENCE, PRESTO, or ZOOKEEPER cluster type.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable release protection for the cluster. Valid values:

*   true: enables release protection for the cluster.
*   false: disables release protection for the cluster.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: DeployMode
parameters.description:
The deployment mode of master nodes in the cluster. Valid values:

*   NORMAL: regular mode. This is the default value. A cluster that contains only one master node is created.
*   HA: high availability (HA) mode. A cluster that contains three master nodes is created.

parameters.name: NodeAttributes
parameters.description: The node attributes. The basic attributes of all ECS nodes in the cluster.

parameters.name: NodeGroups
parameters.description: The array of configurations of the node groups. Number of elements in the array: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing cycle of the instance. Valid values:

*   PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
*   Subscription: subscription

Default value: PayAsYouGo.

parameters.name: ReleaseVersion
parameters.description: The EMR version. You can query available E-MapReduce (EMR) versions in the EMR console.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which to assign the ENI.

parameters.name: SecurityMode
parameters.description:
The security mode of the cluster. Valid values:

*   NORMAL: disables Kerberos authentication for the cluster. This is the default value.
*   KERBEROS: enables Kerberos authentication for the cluster.

parameters.name: SubscriptionConfig
parameters.description: The subscription configurations. This parameter takes effect only if you set the PaymentType parameter to Subscription.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tag. Number of elements in the array: 0 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr create-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzabjyop0000 --payment-type PayAsYouGo --subscription-config example-string --cluster-type DATALAKE --release-version EMR-5.16.0 --cluster-name emrtest --deploy-mode HA --security-mode NORMAL --applications example-string --application-configs example-string --node-attributes example-string --node-groups '["example-string"]' --bootstrap-scripts '["example-string"]' --tags example-string --client-token A7D960FA-6DBA-5E07-8746-A63E3E4D0000 --description Emr_cluster_for_ETL --deletion-protection false --region cn-hangzhou
